a.lede: Company issues first earnings report after ouster of CEO over allegations of affair with suspected Chinese spy Nvidia “does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO”, the chairman of the company’s board said Tuesday. Harvey Jones made the remark during Nvidia’s first quarterly earnings report since Jensen Huang’s ouster. Nvidia announced the same day that its quarterly revenue beat expectations,
a.title: Nvidia doubles revenue as board says it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang

b.lede: The former CEO offered to return to his top role at the company after his resignation last week.
b.title: Nvidia says it doesn’t plan to reappoint Jensen Huang as CEO
